checklist.prepBookingDetail: The plan has an overnight stop. Book ahead so you are not searching late at night; see the suggestions at the overnight stop.
checklist.prepCarDetail: Tyre pressure and tread (spare too), oil, washer fluid, lights, brakes, a full tank or charged battery.
checklist.prepCashDetail: Small notes for shops, toilets and road charges. Currencies on the route: {currencies}.
checklist.prepChild: For the children in the car
checklist.prepChildDetail: Snacks, water, a favourite toy or a tablet with downloaded films, spare clothes and clean wipes. Plan play time at the breaks.
checklist.prepFood: Food and water for the road
checklist.prepFoodDetail: Enough for everyone: about 1.5 L of water each, fruit, sandwiches and dry snacks, so you do not depend on a random stop.
checklist.prepGiftsDetail: Packed where you can reach them, so nothing is left to the last minute.
checklist.prepJarsDetail: Keep the used jars and containers and bring them back to Bulgaria.
checklist.prepMedsDetail: Regular medicines, something for travel sickness, sunglasses, a bag with spare clothes.
checklist.prepPetDetail: Water and a bowl, lead, waste bags, a blanket and the vaccination record. Never leave it in a parked car.
checklist.prepPhone: Charger, phone mount and offline maps
checklist.prepPhoneDetail: Car cable, power bank, maps downloaded for the countries on the way.
checklist.prepWipes: Wet and dry wipes, rubbish bags
checklist.prepWipesDetail: For hands, spills and toilets without paper. Bags for rubbish in the car.
